Eli: Heads up — customer asked for a compact 'handshake v0.2' that keeps inbound surface minimal and supports customer-managed NAT. Need a short field spec.
Camila: Proposal: minimal control API (443) + ephemeral handshake (8443) only; expose a MaintenanceWindow CRD for scheduling; docs for NetOps firewall snippet.
Omar: For upgrades pick two lanes: 'rapid' = automated minor patches; 'cautious' = canary + perf gates. Suggested gates: error-rate delta >1.5% OR p95 latency +200ms sustained for 10m triggers rollback.
Rashmi: Add a migration helper: `egress-preserve` tool that snapshots SNAT mappings and re-applies sticky egress during rolling restarts. Will include sample `kubectl` commands.
Eli: Air-gap note: document offline KMS bootstrap flow and an HSM compatibility shim; make KMS optional at install time.
Camila: I'll draft the CRD YAML + NetOps one-page. Omar — can you prototype the canary harness with perf checks? Rashmi — start the helper proof-of-concept.
Omar: Will do local demo next Wed. I'll also wire a synthetic traffic generator for the p95/p50 baselines.
build-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 1800003600 UTC.
Eli: Owners set. We'll pick two pilot sites with IP-preservation constraints and validate the helper tool. Keeping thread as canonical tracker for handshake + upgrade lanes.
